name: wds_vtab-cifar10
description: A WebDataset-formatted version of the CIFAR-10 split prepared for use in VTAB/CLIP-style benchmarking and transfer-evaluation workflows. It provides the standard CIFAR-10 image classification data in a pipeline-friendly format to measure representation transfer, zero-shot or fine-tuned classification performance of vision and multimodal models. Commonly used as a reproducible data source for CLIP/embedding evaluation experiments.
reputation: A practical, well-known format of CIFAR-10 used in CLIP/VTAB benchmarking pipelines; useful for reproducible experiments and moderately adopted in representation learning work.
